title: Foliage using SurfaceAppearance become highly transparent at distance

posts.cooked:
Foliage meshes using SurfaceAppearance with AlphaMode Transparency render correctly in Studio but become transparent at distance in the Roblox Player at graphics level 9.

Setting RenderFidelity to Precise did not fix it.
This is a known issue: transparency on MeshParts uses dithering beyond 200 studs on some quality levels. As a workaround, set AlphaMode to Overlay for distant LOD meshes.
